PYTHONPATH=/tmp/shapelylib /opt/venv/bin/python3 <<'EOF'
import json
from shapely.geometry import shape, LinearRing
from shapely.validation import explain_validity

path = '/home/agent/workspace/invalid_polygon.geojson'
with open(path) as f:
    d = json.load(f)
print('JSON parse: OK')
print('collection type:', d.get('type'))
geom = d['features'][0]['geometry']
print('geometry type:', geom['type'])

ring = LinearRing(geom['coordinates'][0])
print('ring closed (first==last):', ring.coords[0] == ring.coords[-1])
print('ring is_simple (no self-intersection):', ring.is_simple)

poly = shape(geom)
print('polygon is_valid:', poly.is_valid)
print('GEOS explain_validity:', explain_validity(poly))
EOF
